meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜、节奏与关键帧写成代码,一条命令渲染出成片并发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把动画和视频做成可版本控制的工程,并批量渲染发布。
copy.tagline_en: Render storyboards, beats, and keyframes into finished video from one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want animation and video built as version-controlled code and rendered in batches

howto.what: Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你新建视频项目、编写合成、跑检查、开预览时间线并渲染出视频文件,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、预览或渲染视频合成,或需要排查构建与渲染报错时,它会接管;CLI 需 Node.js 22 以上和 FFmpeg。

say.text: 用 hyperframes init 帮我新建一个视频项目
say.note: 生成居中空白的项目骨架

say.text: 跑一下 hyperframes check，看有没有问题
say.note: 先 lint，再用浏览器审计运行时错误和对比度

say.text: 把成片渲染成 out.mp4，画质用 looks
say.note: 做首次正式编码并确认文件非空

howto.what_en: Claude uses npx hyperframes commands to scaffold a video project, author compositions, lint and check the code, open a timeline preview, and render out video files. It also helps diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, preview, or render a video composition, or to diagnose build or render failures. The CLI requires Node.js 22 or newer and FFmpeg.

say_en.text: Use hyperframes init to set up a new video project
Run hyperframes check to see if anything is wrong
say_en.note: Lints, then audits runtime errors and contrast in a browser

say_en.text: Render the result to out.mp4 with quality looks
say_en.note: First real encode; confirms the file is non-empty
